gap: No result ChatGPT got states the pairing mechanism in the makers' own words: Samsung's compatibility table lists iOS as 'Not supported' for the Galaxy Watch8 series (Android 12.0 or higher, 1.5 GB RAM), Apple requires iPhone 11 or later on iOS 27 for Series 12 / SE 3, and Garmin's manual says text replies are 'available only for compatible Android phones' because the phone, not the watch, sends the SMS, so a Garmin Venu 4 on an iPhone shows texts but cannot answer them.
standout_why: Tech Advisor (cited) only says Apple Watch is 'the obvious choice for iPhone users' and Wear OS for Android, with no OS versions, no Samsung iOS statement and nothing on iPhone text replies. NBC News (uncited top result) says Galaxy Watch 8 is 'compatible with all Android phones' and that ECG, irregular-rhythm and sleep-apnea need a Samsung phone, but gives no minimum Android/RAM, no explicit iOS 'Not supported' and nothing on Garmin reply limits. Android Authority and Wired (cited) returned 403 / blocked, so I could not compare them; ChatGPT's own answer only says 'iPhone & Android' for Garmin and Fitbit. The Samsung-phone-only health features are therefore partly covered (NBC), while the Garmin-on-iPhone reply limit and the maker-stated OS floors are new.
decides: The phone in the shopper's pocket decides the shortlist before any fitness metric does. iPhone owners: Galaxy Watch8/Watch9 and Pixel Watch are out (Samsung: iOS 'Not supported'); Apple Watch SE 3 / Series 12 need iPhone 11+ on iOS 27; Garmin Venu 4 (and Lily 2 Active) and Amazfit pair fine but cannot reply to texts from the wrist. Android owners: Apple Watch is out; Galaxy Watch8 needs Android 12.0+ with 1.5 GB RAM, and blood pressure needs Android 12+ / Wear OS 4.0 with ECG tied to a Galaxy phone via the Galaxy Wearable app. This confirms Garmin Venu 4 as the only pick on ChatGPT's list that works on both platforms, with the reply-to-text caveat for iPhone users.

findings.label: Text reply from watch
findings.value: Available only for compatible Android phones; the preset reply is sent by the phone as an SMS
findings.source_title: Replying to a Text Message - vívoactive 6 Owner's Manual
findings.note: Quoted: 'NOTE: This feature is available only for compatible Android™ phones.' The mechanism is that the watch asks the paired phone to send the SMS; iOS offers no such path to third-party watches, so iPhone users get notifications but no reply. The identical topic appears in Garmin's Instinct Crossover AMOLED and Lily 2 manuals (search results); I did not open a Venu 4-specific copy.
